_what: Which shared packages the APP TEMPLATE delegates to, and which of them a shipping app has not adopted yet. Read and enforced by tooling/ci/assert-chassis-parity.mjs.
_why: THE FACTORY IS THE BASE, AND NOTHING CHECKED THAT THE APPS FOLLOWED IT. [ADR 067] moved the generic
screens and services out of the app and into packages/, and the template was rewritten to delegate to
them. `apps/subscriptiontracker` predates that move and was never migrated — so the NEXT app stamped is
more modern than the app we actually ship, and every fix made in a shared package reaches the template
Measured 2026-09-12: the app imports nikatru_core (44 files), nikatru_design_system (27),
nikatru_auth_supabase (3) — and nikatru_chassis_screens in ZERO. Its pubspec does not even declare the
dependency. Exactly one package is unadopted, and that is the whole of this file.
THIS IS A RATCHET, NOT A PERMISSION SLIP. A row here is a debt that is written down, not a rule that it
is fine. The guard fails when a NEW package goes unadopted, when the declared file list stops matching
the template, and — the direction that matters — when a declared package IS adopted and the row was left
behind. The list can only shrink.
measuredBy: node tooling/ci/assert-chassis-parity.mjs (its own scan; re-run it to re-derive every number here)
rule: Every shared `nikatru_*` package the app template imports must be imported somewhere by every shipping app, unless a row below says why not.

notAdopted.why: The app predates [ADR 067] and carries its own copy of every screen the chassis now owns. Migrating is a real change to live UI, not a rename: the app's settings screen is 1969 lines against the template's 616-line adapter, because it holds app-specific rows the chassis screen takes as parameters. The per-file sizes are recorded in `plan` so the size of the job is visible rather than guessed at.
notAdopted.cost: The app also does not DECLARE the dependency: apps/subscriptiontracker/pubspec.yaml has no nikatru_chassis_screens entry, so the migration starts there.
notAdopted.plan: Screen by screen, smallest first, each with its own PR and its own before/after screenshot: check_inbox (88 -> 23), verify_email (182 -> 47), reaccept_terms (179 -> 57), reset_password (314 -> 77), legal_consent_fields (272 -> 74), sign_up (211 -> 94), manage_plan (238 -> 183), paywall (302 -> 212), app.dart (661 -> 347), main.dart (208 -> 88), settings (1969 -> 616). Delete this row on the last one.
notAdopted._planCorrected2026-09-20: ⏱ [ADR 086] · THE `plan` ABOVE IS LEFT EXACTLY AS WRITTEN; THIS SUPERSEDES THREE OF ITS FIGURES, MEASURED. (1) reaccept_terms landed at 179 -> 103, not 179 -> 57: the residue is larger than the BRICK adapter the plan's target was read off, because it carries this app's own dated reasoning and re-raises a non-AuthFailure sign-out as `core.AuthFailure(authUnknownError)` so the chassis view renders the sentence this app rendered before. The delta is still comfortably negative and is recorded in `adopted`. (2) 🔴 check_inbox WAS BUILT, MEASURED AT 88 -> 35 (callSiteDelta -53), AND THEN DEFERRED — NOT BECAUSE IT DOES NOT WORK. `CheckInboxScreen` is the mutation SUBJECT of M1/M2/M2b in `tooling/ci/test/a11y-coverage.test.mjs`, chosen because it is the only surface in this app swept by exactly ONE family, so deleting its one sweep call is enough to unsweep it. Once it delegates, `assert-a11y-coverage` correctly reports the surface as swept in `packages/chassis_screens` instead of owed, and all three cases stop measuring what they claim. That guard's own PRECONDITION names the two repairs — re-point at another single-family surface, or delete EVERY sweep of the subject — and there is no other single-family surface in this root, while deleting the chassis-side sweeps trips that root's 18-surface and 54-case floors and turns the expected EXIT 1 into a COVERAGE LOST 2. So adopting check_inbox is blocked on re-designing that mutation group, which is a decision about a compliance guard and its own increment. (3) 🔴 `verify_email (182 -> 47)` IS NOT REACHABLE AS STATED AND MUST NOT BE ATTEMPTED AS A RENAME. `apps/subscriptiontracker/lib/features/auth/verify_email_screen.dart` MOUNTS `TurnstileGate` between its resend and continue controls and passes the token to `resendVerificationEmail(captchaToken:)` — `resend` is one of the six Box A captcha-gated endpoints — and maps `core.AuthFailure` through `authErrorText(AppLocalizations.of(context), e)`. `packages/chassis_screens/lib/auth/verify_email_screen.dart` has NEITHER a captcha slot NOR an error mapper: it renders `e.message` and has nowhere to mount the gate. Adopting it as it stands would silently send a null captcha token and downgrade the localized error text, which is a behaviour REGRESSION the call-site line count would have hidden. The same coupling holds for sign_up (TurnstileGate + authErrorText) and, for the error mapper alone, reset_password. Those three need an ADDITIVE optional parameter on the chassis view first — optional, so the brick adapters are untouched — and that package change is its own increment.

The private _OfflineBanner body (Column + OfflineNotice + AppLocalizations) became OfflineBannerHost(unreachable:, onRetry:, child:); +1 import, +3 for the ChassisLocalizations delegate list, +1 dated comment. The chassis host also carries the PR #743 a11y fix the private copy lacked (notice painted after the routed child, so BlockSemantics no longer drops it).

apps/subscriptiontracker/lib/features/auth/reaccept_terms_screen.dart 179 -> 103 lines, both after `dart format` (0 changed), measured with `wc -l` against `git show HEAD:<path>`. The busy latch, the unticked `_accepted` flag, the inline notice and the whole layout moved into `ReacceptTermsView`; what stayed is everything that names a provider or this app's own widgets — `legalAcceptanceProvider.notifier.acceptTermsOnly()`, `signOutAndForgetUser(ref)`, and the `consentFields:` builder that still MOUNTS this app's own `LegalConsentFields` with `showMarketing: false`, so `AppConfig.termsUrl`/`privacyUrl` and the `url_launcher` call never left the app. All three key constants forward to the `ReacceptTermsView` constants, which are the same `Key('reacceptTerms…')` literals. `assert-signup-consent-shape.mjs` reads this surface through the delegation, so its `_accepted` limbs land on the chassis file (guard re-run: EXIT 0, and the adapter is printed as reading 1 chassis file). BEHAVIOUR PRESERVED, not dropped: the chassis view renders `'$e'` for a non-AuthFailure sign-out throw where this app rendered `authUnknownError`, so the adapter re-raises that case as `core.AuthFailure(authUnknownError)` and the view's own `on core.AuthFailure` branch renders the same sentence as before. `reacceptTermsTitle`/`reacceptTermsBody`/`reacceptTermsAccept` are byte-identical between the app arb files and the chassis arb files in both shipped locales.

THE PIECE IS A FUNCTION, NOT A SCREEN. The app's private mapper `apps/subscriptiontracker/lib/features/auth/auth_error_text.dart` (139 lines at 7dd09500) moved with `git mv` to `packages/chassis_screens/lib/auth/auth_error_text.dart`, where every chassis auth view now calls it too; what the app keeps is `features/auth/auth_error_sentence.dart`, 26 lines, a call-through that binds it to `context.chassisL10n` and decides nothing — so the delta is 26 - 139, measured with `wc -l`, the app `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean (Flutter 3.47.5). The four screens that call it moved by login 794 -> 789, sign_up 222 -> 225 (+3: the local length refusal now carries GoTrue's code and reason), reset_password 314 -> 312, verify_email 182 -> 177 — net -9 — and none of them imports the package: `chassis-delegation.mjs` reads a routed screen importing one chassis path as a screen emptied into it, which made all four COVERAGE LOST under `assert-a11y-coverage` when they imported the mapper directly. The strings it returns are chassis keys now; the seven it needed (authIncorrect, authAlreadyRegistered, authConfirmEmail, authRateLimited, authCaptchaFailed, authNetworkError, authUnknownError) were added to `chassis_en.arb`/`chassis_ta.arb` byte-identical to the app's own values in both shipped locales.
